description: Lost your secret key? Give the profile's recovery code to get a new secret_key and a new recovery_code. The old key and the old code stop working at once (each code works once). Balance, items and history stay. Without a recovery code, a person can prove the wallet they paid from at https://agentanthill.com/recover. Attempts are limited per address.

recovery_code.description: The recovery code, starting anthill_rc_ (dashes and case don't matter).

name: anthill_recover_key
title: Get a new key with a recovery code
